title: Harold Tejada Charged in Doping Case, Netcompany-Ineos Move Collapses Before It Begins
content:
The ITA charged Harold Tejada with an anti-doping violation over blood passport abnormalities. Netcompany-Ineos has called off the Colombian's 2027 transfer.

Read the full article at Harold Tejada Charged in Doping Case, Netcompany-Ineos Move Collapses Before It Begins on Velo.
